content.description:
As an experienced SaaS Account Executive at Weave, you will manage a large territory with a focus on daily, weekly, and monthly activities to drive sales. You will be responsible for three key sources of bookings: net new acquisition through targeted prospecting, growth and expansion of existing customer accounts, and management of inbound leads generated from marketing efforts. Utilizing Salesforce, you will meticulously manage the sales pipeline through various stages, accurately forecasting quarterly results and ensuring consistent progress towards closing deals. Pipeline Hygiene and Data Governance will be key in achieving success in this role.

- This position will be remote with hybrid option

- Reports to: Director, Mid-Market & Enterprise Sales

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Drive the full sales cycle from prospecting to deal closure with mid-market organizations

- Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives and decision-makers in healthcare practices

- Conduct compelling product demonstrations and presentations to highlight the value of our communication solutions

- Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve and exceed sales targets

- Stay updated on industry trends and competitive landscapes to effectively position Weave's solutions

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

- 5+ years of experience in SaaS sales, with proficiency in Salesforce and expert-level pipeline management and forecasting skills

- Proven experience managing a quota and consistently achieving performance targets

- Background in the healthcare sector, preferably working with dental, optometry, veterinary, or similar medical professionals

- Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment

WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

- Experience with Dental Service Organizations (DSOs) or corporate entities managing multiple medical practices is highly desirable

- Experience building playbooks for larger segments

- Existing networks within the healthcare space

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.

At Weave, we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to help us work more efficiently and create a smoother candidate experience. AI may assist with things like writing job descriptions, scheduling interviews, or reviewing applications against job-related criteria. For additional information, please review the External AI Policy Statement available on our Careers page.

Weave is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and supported. We welcome anyone who is hungry to learn, problem-solve and progress regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Beware of recruitment fraud. All official correspondence will occur through Weave branded email. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check from us, or purchase software or equipment as part of your interview or hiring process.
